title: Recipe box with search
name: recipes
prompt: A recipe box: I add recipes with a title, ingredients (one per line), steps and tags. Anyone with the link can browse and search recipes by title, ingredient or tag, with typo-tolerant search. Only members can add or edit recipes.

answers: Search should find 'tomatoe' when I mean tomato.

edits: Add a 'scale servings' control that multiplies the ingredient quantities on the recipe page.
Let members mark recipes as favourites and see a list of their own favourites.
